question: Should OpenClaw permanently retain a 512-row restart-only ledger containing closed event codes, stable session fingerprints, actor/device/client metadata, and safe-restart preflight context in the shared state database?
rationale: The implementation can enforce redaction and ordering, but only maintainers can authorize the permanent privacy, retention, and operator-access contract for this new diagnostic data.

options.title: Approve bounded restart ledger
options.body: Accept the metadata-only allowlist and 512-row cap, with a documented or narrowly authorized forensic read path.

options.title: Narrow retained metadata
options.body: Remove correlation fields such as client IP, device identity, or stable session fingerprints before approving persistence.

options.title: Keep diagnostics ephemeral
options.body: Decline durable storage and rely on existing logs or optional diagnostic exporters instead.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded restart ledger
recommendation.body: Accept the metadata-only allowlist and 512-row cap, with a documented or narrowly authorized forensic read path.

likelyOwner.reason: The related audit-direction issue and recent gateway operational history make this the strongest available product-security routing candidate.
